content:
maya: quick note — the onboarding runbook curl example returns 404 in staging. saw it when testing the new CLI snippet this morning. anyone owning that runbook?
liam: ack, saw it too. which path is 404? can you paste the failing curl?
maya: gist: https://staging.redwood.io/runbooks/onboarding/curl-example -> 404
maya: the page used to be /runbooks/onboarding/cli but our shortlink redirect seems off.
dan: @liam fyi (added react :eyes:)
liam: thanks. tagging @anita who touched that runbook last month. anita any chance this is a shortlink regression from the last redirect sweep?
anita: yep that was me — we removed a legacy slug during the doc tidy. i can restore a redirect, but if we want to canonicalize the path i can also push a tiny PR.
maya: either is fine. users hit this on a quickstart script so prefer the redirect for now.
docs-bot: automated-scan: Found 1 dead internal shortlink in /runbooks/onboarding/quickstart (severity: medium). https://internal.docs/scan/1761234567
liam: cool — anita can you drop a one-liner sed for the redirect? i can open the PR and merge if you approve.
anita: copy for the redirect file: `echo "/runbooks/onboarding/cli -> /runbooks/onboarding/quickstart" > content/redirects/onboarding-redirects.md` (then add frontmatter and commit)
jordan: tiny nit — update the sample curl host to staging.redwood-internal so people don't accidentally hit prod in docs examples.
anita: good call. i'll patch both in the same PR.
maya: awesome. rough ETA?
anita: i can open the PR in ~30m and assign to @liam for merge.
liam: i'll review right after lunch. if all green i'll merge and request a short cdn invalidate.
maya: thanks team :thumbsup: once merged can someone drop the staging preview link here so i can re-run my smoke test?
docs-bot: deploybot: preview created for PR #4821 — https://staging.previews.redwood.io/pr-4821 (checks: lint OK, link-check pending)
liam: saw the preview. running link-check now.
liam: link-check ✅ — redirect landing as expected, curl sample yields 200. planning to merge at 12:45pm PT.
maya: perfect, thanks all.
anita: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4821 — assigned @liam for merge.
jordan: added a quick comment in the PR re: host value, nothing blocking.
liam: merged and invalidated CDN. staging preview still serves correct content. closing loop here. :white_check_mark:
